capabilities: Toggle in place between the detailed editor and a read-only quick view of marked sections
Mark ranges by selecting text or right-clicking headings, lists, callouts, tables, or code blocks
Toggle task checkboxes in the quick view with atomic write-back to the source Markdown
Jump from a projected section back to its exact line in the editor
Store ranges as top-level Markdown comments inside the note
disambiguation: Not a quick switcher or file previewer; it projects marked sections of the current note, not other notes.
extras: Bilingual README (English/Chinese). The install section says the plugin is recommended 'once listed', implying it is not yet in the community plugin directory, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view only selected key excerpts of a note in a read-only projection while the full note stays the single editable source.
summary: Projects marked sections of a note into a clean, read-only quick view, toggled in place against the Live Preview editor.
